topSignals.title: The quietest stretch yet: no new item in any monitored section — Elcogen now 45 days quiet, Topsoe 70 days.
topSignals.text: Dedicated English- and German-language searches for both priority stacks, the full Tier 2 and Tier 3 rotations, every standing sweep query, and broad AI-datacenter/hyperscaler, regulation, competing-power, market/financials, research/IP, and scientific-paper checks all returned only recycled/already-logged background or out-of-window items. No SOFC order, PPA, pilot, regulatory action, earnings move, or benchmark datapoint was found today. Elcogen News | Topsoe press releases

items.text: Elcogen (priority): No new news-archive item since Sept 21, 2026 (Metrosert cooperation), confirmed via English- and German-language searches today — 45 days quiet. Status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform (75% FC electrical efficiency / 90% with heat recovery, 33 kWh/kg H2 SOEC — vendor claims) in volume production at the 360 MW/yr ELCO I Tallinn factory.

Topsoe (priority): No new solid-oxide-specific release since the Aug 27, 2026 H1 2026 results/SOEC pathway reset, confirmed via English- and German-language searches today — 70 days quiet; topsoe.com/press-releases remains dominated by PTX/ammonia/SAF/blue-hydrogen news, out of SOFC/SOEC scope.

Today's Tier 2 dedicated rotation — round 3 (Kyocera, Aisin): no new stack/cell-technology items for either; results were SEO-aggregator (enkiai.com) recaps of standing 2025-vintage SOFC-cogeneration background and routine autoparts-sector coverage, no new 2026 primary disclosure.

Tier 2 sweep — "Bloom Energy OR FuelCell Energy OR Ceres Power OR Sunfire OR SolydEra": no new item; results recycled standing background (Bloom's 60%-electrical-efficiency hydrogen-SOFC announcement, Cummins/Ceres DOE deal, Ceres/Goldman Sachs upgrade). A recirculating "Ceres Power shares soar on China data centre power deal" headline was checked and confirmed dated Nov 5, 2025 (the Ceres-Weichai licensing deal, already on file) — exactly one year old, not new.

Today's Tier 3 dedicated rotation — new cycle 7, round 1 (Reverion, Convion, Hexis, Doosan Fuel Cell, SK ecoplant, Weichai), 7-day lookback: no new items for any of the six; results repeated the standing Sept 29 Reverion $175M/€150M Series B and Sept 18 Doosan-Reverion $78M stack order (a German-language cleanthinking.de follow-up citing a "€2bn order pipeline" and "800 jobs" for Reverion's megafactory was checked — same Sept 29/30 announcement cluster, not a new datapoint), Convion's 2024 HD Hyundai acquisition history, Hexis's dormant ownership background, SK ecoplant's 2023-vintage GDS Singapore story, and Weichai's standing SOFC-backup-generator positioning.

Tier 3 sweep — "Watt Fuel Cell OR OxEon Energy OR Nexceris OR Kawasaki Heavy Industries OR Miura OR Fraunhofer IKTS": no new item; results repeated the standing Miura/Ceres 4.2 kW CHP Japan launch, Nexceris's $60M SOEC-scaling deal, and Fraunhofer IKTS interconnect-research background.
Competitor roster: SOFC systems for data centers

Bloom Energy: Deployed/signed at multiple named sites — Oracle/Project Jupiter (NM, installation underway, Dec 7 air-permit hearing confirmed), AEP (1 GW), Brookfield EaaS, Nebius (328 MW/$2.6B, Vineland NJ), Equinix (>100 MW/19 sites), Aligned "Project Phoenix" (2 GW, PA), Hitachi (Japan), SK Eternix (Icheon/Paju, Korea, 28 MW, operational).

FuelCell Energy (incl. HyAxiom-branded products): Signed orders/PPAs — Fit Energy (up to 380 MW), Inuverse Korea (up to 100 MW), 75 MW Texas Capacity Reservation Agreement, SDCL (up to 450 MW). No named deployment live yet.

Doosan Fuel Cell/HyAxiom: Signed order — US AI data center supply contract (KRW 823.6B cumulative, mixed SOFC/PAFC); separately supplies SOFC stacks to Reverion. No named data-center site of its own yet.
Convion: Pipeline-only/pre-commercial under HD Hyundai ownership; no named data-center customer.
SK ecoplant: Pipeline-only (2023-vintage GDS Singapore SOFC deal); no new named data-center deployment.
Ceres Power's SOFC licensees (Doosan, Delta Electronics, Weichai): Licensing/pipeline-only; no named data-center deployment via Ceres licensing directly.
Reverion: Pipeline-only — Doosan-supplied SOFC stacks for rSOC power plants (Germany); no named data-center customer yet.
Petra Power: Pre-commercial, no named customer; first infrastructure deployment targeted 2028.
